about: X8: the bundled program_checks.py on checks-lathe.nc with its form defaults, no machine chosen. The whole report; every row with a line jumps to it.

report.title: Program checks

rows.message: G96: constant surface speed with no spindle speed clamp before it; the spindle speeds up as the diameter shrinks
a subprogram call inside the profile N100 to N200 that G71 on line 13 runs
G70: Q300 names no block of this program
G01 Z-10. F0.2: a cut after T0100 cancelled the tool offset (line 21), with no tool call between
Z2000: read as 2000 mm by 'As written' (the assumed default), 2 mm by 'Increments of 0.001 mm (IS-B)' or 0.2 mm by 'Increments of 0.0001 mm (IS-C)'; choose a machine
G92 X19.4 Z-18. F1.5: a thread cut under constant surface speed; the speed changes with the diameter and the lead may not follow
G68.2: the control refuses it while constant surface speed is on
G00 X0. Z5.: a move between M29 (line 46) and the tapping cycle
T0606: a tool change while the cycle G84 (line 49) is in force
T0202 T0303: 2 T words in one block
G01 X40. F0.1: a cut while the spindle is stopped (M05 on line 58)
G65: has to stand in a block of its own; the block writes G00 in front of it or another G code
DO1: no END1 follows in the program
GOTO 900: no block N900 in this program
X123456.789: 9 digits once it is converted to increments; the control takes at most 8
(FEED 100% FROM HERE): a % inside a comment ends the program when it is read in from tape or a serial line
(RETRACT, THE COMMENT IS NOT CLOSED: the comment is opened with ( and not closed with ) on its line
#2=[#1+1: a [ is opened and not closed on its line
g00, z100.: written in lower case; this control reads its addresses in upper case
–: – (en dash) is not an ASCII character, outside a comment
M00: Program stop
M01: Optional stop
G00 X100. Z100.: after the program end M30 on line 79; it never runs

report.message: 23 findings in 22 checks. No machine chosen: where the presets read a number differently, the finding lists every reading.
